prompt: Implement an approved feature with a frozen HTTP contract, one backend slice, and one independent client slice.
context: The API schema, consumer contract tests, disjoint write sets, base commit, and integration owner are explicit.
expected_orchestration: Allow two isolated writers because the contract is frozen and write sets are disjoint. Integrate centrally and run consumer, backend, and end-to-end checks.
acceptance_checks: Each writer receives a complete task packet and separate worktree.
Neither writer edits the shared contract.
Combined contract and acceptance tests pass in the integration worktree.
failure_signals: A writer silently changes the shared contract.
Workers use a shared writable checkout.
A clean merge is treated as sufficient validation.
